title: Shakespeare's The Twelfth Night
description: Served as a prop's designer, developing and coordinating the props to support the production's playful playground setting. Designed, sourced, and created props that reflected the characters, world, and visual style of the production while collaborating with the creative team.
image_alt: Actors performing on a theatre stage surrounded by scenic elements and props

title: The Servant of Two Masters
description: A prop begins as an object, but onstage it has to carry character, history, and intention. In The servant of Two Masters, I contributed to the creation, painting, and finishing of props, using hands-on craftsmanship to support the visual style and comedic energy of the production.
image_alt: Theatre tools and production materials arranged on a work surface

title: BUILDING THE WORLD
description: I served as the soundboard operator for State of La Danse. I supported movement, rhythm, and atmosphere through sound. I launched music cues in close relationship to the dancer's timing. I also maintained consistent sound levels to allow choreography to be clear
